title: Exceptional supersphere integration and logarithmic Pizzetti kernels
summary: We study orthosymplectically invariant supersphere integration at the exceptional superdimensions $M=-2u$, where the harmonic Fischer structure becomes nonsemisimple and the Pizzetti pairing degenerates. For the meromorphically continued homogeneous inverse kernels we obtain the generating function $$ \mathscr G_μ(ρ;x,y) =\frac{Γ(μ/2)}{2π^{μ/2}} \bigl(1+ρ\{x,y\}+ρ^2x^2y^2\bigr)^{-μ/2}. $$ At $μ=-2u$, its Laurent expansion has a polynomial residue and a logarithmic finite part.
